assertion: Biden’s record-breaking 106,109-page 2024 Federal Register contained 3,248 final rules, including 342 designated significant.
reason: Pages 106,109 and 3,248 rules confirmed (CEI PDF and warehouse 3,248). 342 is CEI's figure; warehouse flag today 345, a revision-level difference.
sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' GROUP BY year

assertion: Trump’s first year back in office produced 2,441 final rules, the lowest rule count of all time, with 155 of them significant.
reason: Warehouse 2,442 (one document off); lowest in warehouse 2010-2026 and per CEI PDF since the 1970s. The 155 significant is CEI's figure; warehouse flag today shows 189 (revision difference). 243 of the 2,441 were Biden's January rules, which the blog omits.
sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' GROUP BY year
independent_value: 10KC PDF pp. 9, 39: 2,441 lowest of all time; 155 significant
measure: Federal Register final rules significant rules count

assertion: As of today, the 75,742-page Federal Register contains 2,639 final rules, putting the year on track for roughly 2,946, which would still be a historic low, since only in the Trump administrations have rule counts dropped below 3,000. There are 190 significant rules.
reason: Warehouse: 2,639 final rules and 190 significant through 2026-11-23. Projection 2,639 x 365/327 = 2,946 matches (an estimate). Warehouse 2010-2025 has only 2019 (2,964) and 2025 (2,442) under 3,000. Page count 75,742 not in warehouse.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), MAX(publication_date) FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' AND year='2026'
independent_value: CEI PDF p.39 on sub-3,000 years

assertion: Significant refers to a significant regulatory action as specified in Executive Order 12866, often but not exclusively those with at least $100 million annual economic impact.
reason: EO 12866 defines significant to include $100 million effect, novel legal or policy issues and other criteria; 'often but not exclusively' is accurate.

assertion: I found 166 significant rules issued for the “fiscal year” that ended September 30. Of these, 86 were deregulatory, 34 were conventionally regulatory, and 46 best classified as technical corrections.
reason: Warehouse: 166 significant final rules among 2,238 published Jan 1 to Sept 30, 2026 ('fiscal year' is CEI's own quoted, looser usage). The 86/34/46 split is CEI's subjective classification.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN significant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fedregister.fr_documents_significance WHERE doc_type='RULE' AND year='2026' AND publication_date<='2026-09-30'
independent_value: CEI Oct 5 post read in full
